name: S4 - audhumbla baseline, before the milk
description: One game, as she is today. Her Regen-as-ammo rebuild is designed but not built - capture what's wrong precisely first. Count the turns where you had an actual choice (predicted: near zero). Note every moment you would have DRUNK the Regen pile if the payoff card existed - if those moments are frequent and tense, the rebuild is right; if you never wished for it, say so before it's built.
